title: Regulatory Submission Source
description: Regulatory Submission contract normalized from the DocuBricks Legal library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-legal-regulatory-submission-source
  title: Regulatory Submission Source
  description: Regulatory Submission contract normalized from the DocuBricks Legal library.
  version: legal_regulatory_submission_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: legal/regulatory_submission
    sourcePath: Schemas/legal/regulatory_submission
    sourceVersion: legal_regulatory_submission_v1
    sourceDigest: ade1432ee052eb8ca9ad61046f1c2748b23b95b4d2927bd7e785b0def0f8b818
    derivedFrom: docubricks-legal-regulatory-submission
spec:
  documentType: regulatory_submission
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - acceptance-date
        - cover-letter-date
        - decision-date
        - filing-period-from
        - filing-period-to
        - submission-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - confidentiality-request
        - regulator
        - review-division
        - subject-of-submission
        - submission-id
        - submission-type
        - submitting-entity-id
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - submitting-entity-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - material-change-described
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - submission-status
  fields:
    - id: submission-type
      name: submission_type
      label: Submission Type
      description: "The specific type of regulatory submission. Examples:"
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/submission_type
    - id: regulator
      name: regulator
      label: Regulator
      description: "The regulatory body receiving the submission. One of: FDA | SEC | FinCEN | CFTC | FINRA | FTC |
        CFPB | State | Other"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/regulator
    - id: submission-date
      name: submission_date
      label: Submission Date
      description: Date the submission was filed or submitted, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/submission_date
    - id: acceptance-date
      name: acceptance_date
      label: Acceptance Date
      description: Date the regulator formally accepted the submission for review, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if not stated)
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/acceptance_date
    - id: decision-date
      name: decision_date
      label: Decision Date
      description: Date the regulator issued a final decision, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if pending or not stated)
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/decision_date
    - id: submission-status
      name: submission_status
      label: Submission Status
      description: "Current status of the submission. One of: Accepted | Under_Review | Approved | Refused |
        Withdrawn | Pending | Deficient | null"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/submission_status
    - id: submission-id
      name: submission_id
      label: Submission Id
      description: The unique identifier assigned to the submission. This may be a docket number (FDA), accession
        number (SEC EDGAR), CTR/SAR reference number (FinCEN), or other regulatory reference ID
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/submission_id
    - id: cover-letter-date
      name: cover_letter_date
      label: Cover Letter Date
      description: Date of the cover letter accompanying the submission, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if no cover letter)
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/cover_letter_date
    - id: filing-period-from
      name: filing_period_from
      label: Filing Period From
      description: Start date of the filing period (e.g., fiscal year start for 10-K, quarter start for 10-Q),
        format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/filing_period_from
    - id: filing-period-to
      name: filing_period_to
      label: Filing Period To
      description: End date of the filing period (e.g., fiscal year end for 10-K), format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/filing_period_to
    - id: submitting-entity-name
      name: submitting_entity_name
      label: Submitting Entity Name
      description: Full legal name of the entity filing the submission
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/submitting_entity_name
    - id: submitting-entity-id
      name: submitting_entity_id
      label: Submitting Entity Id
      description: The primary regulatory identifier for the submitting entity. This may be a CIK (SEC), LEI, EIN,
        FDA Establishment Identifier, or other ID
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/submitting_entity_id
    - id: review-division
      name: review_division
      label: Review Division
      description: The specific division, branch, or office within the regulator that reviews this submission (null
        if not applicable or not stated)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/review_division
    - id: subject-of-submission
      name: subject_of_submission
      label: Subject Of Submission
      description: Brief description of the subject matter of the filing (up to 300 chars)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/subject_of_submission
    - id: material-change-described
      name: material_change_described
      label: Material Change Described
      description: Boolean — true if the submission discloses or describes a material change, event, or condition
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/material_change_described
    - id: confidentiality-request
      name: confidentiality_request
      label: Confidentiality Request
      description: Boolean — true if the submitting entity has requested confidential treatment of all or part of
        the submission
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/confidentiality_request
  validationRules:
    - id: document-id-present
      severity: error
      description: Every extracted record must carry a document_id — system invariant required for lineage tracking,
        regulatory audit trail, and deduplication
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: document_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: document_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: document_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(document_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: avg-confidence-acceptable
      severity: warning
      description: Regulatory submissions require a higher confidence threshold (0.72) due to the legal and
        compliance risk of misclassified filings; route low-confidence records to human review
      rule:
        op: gte
        left:
          field: avg_confidence
        right:
          value: 0.72
      sourceExpression: avg_confidence >= 0.72
      supported: true
    - id: submission-type-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Submission type is required to route the record to the correct compliance workflow; null or empty
        values prevent downstream processing
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: submission_type
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: submission_type
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: submission_type IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(submission_type)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: submitting-entity-name-not-null
      severity: warning
      description: The submitting entity name is a critical identifier for regulatory tracking and OFAC/KYC
        screening; records without it cannot be processed
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: submitting_entity_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: submitting_entity_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: submitting_entity_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(submitting_entity_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: submission-id-present
      severity: warning
      description: Submission ID (docket number, accession number, reference ID) is required to correlate with
        regulator records and track filing status
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: submission_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: submission_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: submission_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(submission_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: submission-date-present
      severity: warning
      description: Submission date is necessary to calculate response deadlines, monitor review timelines, and meet
        regulatory reporting SLAs
      rule:
        op: present
        field: submission_date
      sourceExpression: submission_date IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: decision-date-after-submission
      severity: warning
      description: Decision date cannot precede submission date; inversion indicates a date extraction error and
        flags the record for human review
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: decision_date
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: submission_date
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: decision_date
            right:
              field: submission_date
      sourceExpression: decision_date IS NULL OR submission_date IS NULL OR decision_date >= submission_date
      supported: true
    - id: submission-status-valid-enum
      severity: warning
      description: Submission status must be a recognized enumeration for accurate compliance dashboard reporting
        and workflow routing
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: submission_status
          - op: or
            rules:
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: submission_status
                right:
                  value: Accepted
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: submission_status
                right:
                  value: Under_Review
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: submission_status
                right:
                  value: Approved
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: submission_status
                right:
                  value: Refused
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: submission_status
                right:
                  value: Withdrawn
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: submission_status
                right:
                  value: Pending
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: submission_status
                right:
                  value: Deficient
      sourceExpression: submission_status IS NULL OR submission_status IN ('Accepted', 'Under_Review', 'Approved',
        'Refused', 'Withdrawn', 'Pending', 'Deficient')
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      submission_id:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Submission ID (docket number, accession number) is the primary key for correlating with regulator
          records; must be extracted exactly as formatted to ensure accurate docket tracking
      submission_date:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Submission date is the legal anchor for calculating regulatory response deadlines, review clocks,
          and compliance reporting periods; errors can cause missed deadlines with enforcement consequences
      submitting_entity_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Entity name is required for OFAC screening, KYC/AML compliance, and regulatory relationship
          management; errors affect reporting accuracy
      submission_status:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Submission status drives compliance dashboard reporting and escalation workflows; an incorrect
          status can mask deficiencies requiring immediate action
      submission_type:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Submission type routes the record to the correct regulatory workflow; misclassification leads to
          wrong review procedures and reporting errors
      regulator:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Regulator identification is essential for routing to the correct compliance team and external
          reporting system
      submitting_entity_id:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Entity ID (CIK, LEI, EIN) is required for automated regulatory lookup and entity resolution; errors
          break cross-system reconciliation
      decision_date:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Decision date drives compliance lifecycle close-out and regulatory timeline reporting; must be
          accurate
      filing_period_from:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Filing period start anchors the reporting period for financial and regulatory analysis
      filing_period_to:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Filing period end defines the scope of reported data; must align with the reporting period declared
          in the submission
      material_change_described:
        minConfidence: 0.8
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Material change flag triggers escalation to legal and compliance review teams; false negatives
          could suppress critical alerts
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-haiku
    maxTokens: 8192
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Regulatory submissions span a wide range of formats and lengths — from short FinCEN CTR forms to
      multi-hundred-page FDA PMAs and SEC 10-K filings. Claude Sonnet is preferred for its ability to
      correctly classify submission types across different regulatory domains (FDA, SEC, FinCEN, CFTC, FINRA),
      accurately extract regulatory identifiers in varying formats (EDGAR accession numbers, FDA K-numbers,
      SEC CIK codes), and interpret regulatory-specific terminology. The maximum token budget (8192) is
      required to accommodate lengthy regulatory filings, cover letters, and supporting summaries. Temperature
      0.0 ensures deterministic extraction of regulatory identifiers and dates where precision is legally
      required. Claude Haiku serves as fallback for simple, structured form submissions (e.g., FinCEN CTR)
      where the layout is predictable and reasoning depth is less critical.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      submission_type:
        type: string
        description: "The specific type of regulatory submission. Examples:"
      regulator:
        type: string
        description: "The regulatory body receiving the submission. One of: FDA | SEC | FinCEN | CFTC | FINRA | FTC |
          CFPB | State | Other"
      submission_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the submission was filed or submitted, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      acceptance_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the regulator formally accepted the submission for review, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if not
          stated)
        format: date
      decision_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the regulator issued a final decision, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if pending or not stated)
        format: date
      submission_status:
        type: string
        description: "Current status of the submission. One of: Accepted | Under_Review | Approved | Refused |
          Withdrawn | Pending | Deficient | null"
      submission_id:
        type: string
        description: The unique identifier assigned to the submission. This may be a docket number (FDA), accession
          number (SEC EDGAR), CTR/SAR reference number (FinCEN), or other regulatory reference ID
      cover_letter_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of the cover letter accompanying the submission, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if no cover letter)
        format: date
      filing_period_from:
        type: string
        description: Start date of the filing period (e.g., fiscal year start for 10-K, quarter start for 10-Q),
          format YYYY-MM-DD
      filing_period_to:
        type: string
        description: End date of the filing period (e.g., fiscal year end for 10-K), format YYYY-MM-DD
      submitting_entity_name:
        type: string
        description: Full legal name of the entity filing the submission
      submitting_entity_id:
        type: string
        description: The primary regulatory identifier for the submitting entity. This may be a CIK (SEC), LEI, EIN,
          FDA Establishment Identifier, or other ID
      review_division:
        type: string
        description: The specific division, branch, or office within the regulator that reviews this submission (null
          if not applicable or not stated)
      subject_of_submission:
        type: string
        description: Brief description of the subject matter of the filing (up to 300 chars)
      material_change_described:
        type: string
        description: Boolean — true if the submission discloses or describes a material change, event, or condition
      confidentiality_request:
        type: string
        description: Boolean — true if the submitting entity has requested confidential treatment of all or part of
          the submission
    required:
      - submission_type
      - submitting_entity_name
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: regulatory_exams_audit
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - submission_type
          - submitting_entity_name
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
